description: Extract bordered tables from a text-based PDF into CSV and JSON with source page numbers. Maximum 3 MB and 10 pages. Scans and borderless tables are unsupported. Costs 10 cents per document page after the trial allowance; no charge when no useful tables are found.

pdfBase64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes, maximum 3 MB decoded.

name: tablelift_extract_tables
